summary: Tested new telemetry/monitoring feature end-to-end (backend + frontend) + regression. 15/15 pytest tests passed and all Playwright UI assertions passed.

backend: POST /api/computers/{id}/telemetry: valid push 200, wrong key 401, missing key 401, unknown computer 404, out-of-range 422
GET /api/computers/{id}: live monitoring with correct cpu/ram/storage/hostname after push; PC-050 returns monitoring='none', online=false, no last_heartbeat
GET /api/agent/download: admin & technician 200 with Content-Disposition attachment filename=agent.py, placeholders substituted, AGENT_API_KEY present; user 403; no token 401
frontend: /computers/PC-001 monitoring-card shows mode='live', online-status='Online', three usage bars, last-heartbeat text with 'Last heartbeat:' and uptime
/computers/PC-050 shows mode='no agent', online-status='Offline', no-agent-notice visible, bars hidden
agent-setup-card: download-agent-btn triggers download of agent.py file; agent-run-cmd text 'python agent.py --id PC-001'
Polling: pushed cpu=88 via API, waited 13s, UI auto-refreshed to show 88% without reload
Regression: computers list page and reports page load

critical_code_review_comments: download_agent uses request.headers['origin'] which may be absent for direct GETs; falls back to request.base_url which is typically the internal URL. PUBLIC_URL env can be set for safer substitution.

apply_liveness returns monitoring='live' even when offline (age > 120s). The frontend compensates by checking c.online, but semantically the mode could be 'offline' separate from 'live'. Current test expectations are satisfied.
